name: Entropic Shroud

effects.name: Entropic Shroud
effects.desc: Void-Touched Wild Shape. Entropic Strikes: your beast form's natural weapon attacks deal +1d4 Necrotic or Psychic (your choice — edit [necrotic] to [psychic] to switch). Baleful Presence: once per turn on a melee hit, use the Baleful Presence action. You can revert to normal Wild Shape appearance at any time (remove this effect) while keeping your beast statistics.

effects.text:
You use **Wild Shape** and cloak your beast form in inky darkness, swirling starlight, or crackling void energy.
**Entropic Strikes** — natural weapon attacks deal an extra **1d4 Necrotic or Psychic** (your choice).
**Baleful Presence** — once per turn when you hit with a melee attack, run the **Baleful Presence** action on the target.

verb: wild shapes, wreathed in the hush of the Void,
